sentences.zh: 他们的父亲，也就是这个叫詹姆斯的男人，正深陷骗局之中。

sentences.en: He'd sent hundreds of thousands of dollars to Mexico.

sentences.en: And he was considering sending another $157,000 when his daughter decided to call up this law firm and try to get her father to stop, stop sending money to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 而且他正考虑再汇157,000美元，这时他的女儿决定打电话给这家律师事务所，试图阻止她的父亲，阻止他继续给墨西哥汇钱。

sentences.en: So I called him a few weeks ago as I was trying to understand what was going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我几周前给他打了电话，当时我正试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 詹姆斯是加利福尼亚州的一名退休州警。

She just reminded me of 72.

sentences.en: And they're both in their early 70s, and they own this timeshare that is in Lake Tahoe, California, and they bought it in the 1990s for about $8,000.
sentences.zh: 他们都刚过70岁，他们在加利福尼亚州太浩湖拥有一处分时度假屋，那是他们在20世纪90年代花大约8,000美元买的。

sentences.en: And for someone who did not grow up vacationing in a timeshare,
sentences.zh: 对于一个没有在分时度假屋度过童年假期的人来说，

sentences.en: Remind me how exactly timeshares work.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我一下，分时度假到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Timeshares are essentially vacation properties and they tend to be beach resorts.
sentences.zh: 分时度假本质上就是度假房产，而且往往是海滨度假村。

sentences.en: And multiple people can buy into this property.
sentences.zh: 多个人可以买下这处房产的份额。

sentences.en: The ownership is a shared ownership.
sentences.zh: 这种所有权是共享所有权。

sentences.en: And this gives you the right to use the timeshare for one to two weeks out of every year.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了你在每年中可以使用该分时度假屋一到两周的权利。

sentences.en: And so James and Nikki use their timeshare every other year with their daughters.
sentences.zh: 所以詹姆斯和妮基每隔一年会和他们的女儿们一起使用他们的分时度假屋。

sentences.en: But as they hit retirement age and their daughters are growing up and starting their own families, they're just not really using it that much anymore.
sentences.zh: 但随着他们到了退休年龄，女儿们也长大了并开始组建自己的家庭，他们其实不怎么去那里了。

sentences.en: And timeshares require the owners to pay off yearly maintenance fees.
sentences.zh: 分时度假要求所有者支付年度维护费。

sentences.en: And so they're starting to think about maybe letting go of their timeshare and selling it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始考虑放弃分时度假屋并把它卖掉。

sentences.en: But then one day in late 2022, James gets a phone call from a company that is purporting to be based out of Atlanta, Georgia, called Worry-Free Vacations.
sentences.zh: 但后来在2022年底的一天，詹姆斯接到了一家自称总部设在佐治亚州亚特兰大的公司的电话，该公司名叫“无忧度假”。

sentences.en: Worry-Free Vacations.
sentences.zh: 无忧度假。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That sounds enticing.
sentences.zh: 听起来很诱人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And they start off with a simple question, which is, do you want to buy a timeshare?
sentences.zh: 他们从一个简单的问题开始，那就是，你想买分时度假屋吗？

sentences.en: And James says, I already have a timeshare.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯说，我已经有一个分时度假屋了。

sentences.en: And then they say, great.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，太好了。

sentences.en: Well, what about selling the timeshare?
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑一下卖掉分时度假屋呢？

sentences.en: Do you want to sell?
sentences.zh: 你想卖吗？

sentences.en: There's this Mexican businessman, and he's interested in your timeshare, and he's willing to buy it for about $20,000.
sentences.zh: 这里有一位墨西哥商人，他对你的分时度假屋很感兴趣，他愿意出大约20,000美元买下它。

sentences.en: And James jumps at the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯一听到这个机会就心动了。

sentences.en: And did he do anything to try and verify that this was real?
sentences.zh: 他有没有做过什么来试图验证这是真的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: So remember, James is former law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 所以记住，詹姆斯以前是执法人员。

sentences.en: And he feels very confident in his abilities to kind of sniff out untrustworthy people.
sentences.zh: 他对自己辨别不可信之人的能力非常有信心。

sentences.en: So he goes online and he Googles this Mexican businessman and sees that, yeah, he is a real person.
sentences.zh: 于是他上网用谷歌搜索了这位墨西哥商人，发现没错，他是一个真实存在的人。

sentences.en: He's a very well-respected individual in Mexico, you know, very well off.
sentences.zh: 他在墨西哥是一位备受尊敬的人物，你知道的，非常有钱。

sentences.en: And this makes James feel at ease, you know, that he's selling to a legitimate person, that worry-free vacations are who they claim to be.
sentences.zh: 这让詹姆斯感到放心，觉得他是把房产卖给了一个合法的人，“无忧度假”公司也确实如他们所说的那样。

sentences.en: and that he's going to double his money overnight, essentially.
sentences.zh: 而且他的钱基本上在一夜之间就能翻倍。

sentences.en: And what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, a couple of weeks after he makes the agreement with the buyer, he's told that he needs to send a couple of thousand dollars to facilitate the purchase.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在他与买家达成协议几周后，他被告知需要寄几千美元来促成这笔交易。

sentences.en: What does that mean, facilitate?
sentences.zh: 促成是什么意思？

sentences.en: I can't remember specifically whether it was supposed to be cross-border registration.
sentences.zh: 我记不清具体是说这是跨境注册费还是别的什么了。

sentences.en: So he's being told that there are these fees that are paid directly to the Mexican government.
sentences.zh: 所以他被告知这些费用是直接支付给墨西哥政府的。

sentences.en: Or SPID or some other fee that was Mexican government required or not.
sentences.zh: 或者是SPID或其他一些墨西哥政府要求的费用，不管是不是吧。

sentences.en: A lot of these fees are the same types of fees that you would pay in the United States for a real estate transaction.
sentences.zh: 其中许多费用与你在美国进行房地产交易所需要支付的费用是同类型的。

sentences.en: So he begins wiring money to an account in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始往墨西哥的一个账户电汇资金。

sentences.en: After that, a few days later, we get a notification, well, everything went well, except that we have to pay an additional fee.
sentences.zh: 在那之后几天，我们收到通知，嗯，一切都很顺利，只是我们必须支付一笔额外的费用。

sentences.en: Every time that he sends one fee, he's being told that, you know, he's got to send another fee right afterwards.
sentences.zh: 他每汇出一笔费用，就会被告知，你知道的，他紧接着必须再汇另一笔费用。

sentences.en: Does he get suspicious at any point?
sentences.zh: 他有没有在某个时候产生怀疑？

sentences.en: His wife is suspicious.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: us.
sentences.zh: 我们。

sentences.en: After, you know, the first couple of payments, she starts saying, this does not feel right.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在前几次付款之后，她开始说，这感觉不对劲。

sentences.en: But, you know, James is the former law enforcement officer, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，詹姆斯是前执法人员嘛。

sentences.en: And he's the one that basically handles the family finances.
sentences.zh: 而且他是那个基本上负责家里财务的人。

sentences.en: And he's confident that all of this is going to work out because he's being told that the buyer of the timeshare will reimburse James for all of these
sentences.zh: 他坚信这一切都会顺利解决，因为有人告诉他，一旦交易完成，分时度假的买家会向詹姆斯报销所有这些

sentences.en: fees once the sale goes through.
sentences.zh: 费用。

sentences.en: Michael from the Warrior Free Vacations was constantly reassuring your money's in that account.
sentences.zh: “无忧度假”的迈克尔不断向他保证，你的钱就在那个账户里。

sentences.en: Check with the commercial escrow account.
sentences.zh: 去跟商业托管账户核实一下。

sentences.en: It's there.
sentences.zh: 钱就在那儿。

sentences.en: It's just these big fees have to be paid and you're being reimbursed for all of this.
sentences.zh: 只是必须支付这些巨额费用，而且你所有的支出都会得到报销。

sentences.en: They're sending James documents that show all of the reimbursements that he's owed and how much money he's going to get.
sentences.zh: 他们给詹姆斯发送了文件，上面显示了他应得的所有报销以及他将获得多少钱。

sentences.en: And this just makes him feel like, you know, all of this is kosher.
sentences.zh: 这让他觉得，你知道的，这一切都是合法的。

sentences.en: We have this commercial escrow company that was involved out of New York.
sentences.zh: 我们有一家来自纽约的商业托管公司参与其中。

sentences.en: So there was an air of legitimacy that I was comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种让我感到安心的合法氛围。

sentences.en: You know, maybe, OK, these guys just need one more fee and everything is going to finally be cleared.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许吧，好吧，这些人只需要再交一笔费用，一切最终就会全部办妥。

sentences.en: But about a year in, James starts to get suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但在大约一年后，詹姆斯开始产生怀疑。

sentences.en: He begins asking questions because he wants his money.
sentences.zh: 他开始提出疑问，因为他想要回自己的钱。

sentences.en: And every time I asked, hey, is there a way I can get a partial release of these funds, there was always, no, these funds have to be paid from your account before they're released.
sentences.zh: 每次我问，嘿，有没有什么办法能让我部分提取这些资金时，得到的回答总是，不行，这些资金必须从你的账户支付后才能释放。

sentences.en: But worry-free vacations, they pivot.
sentences.zh: 但是“无忧度假”公司改变了说辞。

sentences.en: And they tell him that, listen, you know, there are all these complications.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，听着，你知道的，有这么多的复杂情况。

sentences.en: It's going to be really hard to get your money out from this transaction.
sentences.zh: 要从这笔交易中把你的钱取出来将会非常困难。

sentences.en: I could pay about $30,000 and change to reinvest the $313,000 into an environmentally conscious development in Loretto, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我本可以支付大约3万零几美元，把这31万3千美元重新投资到墨西哥洛雷托的一个环保开发项目里。

sentences.en: Instead, we've got this other investment opportunity in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们在墨西哥有另一个投资机会。

sentences.en: And I'm sure you know where that is over on the east coast of Aja.
sentences.zh: 我确信你知道那在哪里，就在下加利福尼亚半岛的东海岸。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And that is going to make you a huge return, even more money than you had thought that you were going to make, much more than the $20,000.
sentences.zh: 那将为你带来巨大的回报，比你原本想象能赚到的钱还要多得多，远不止那2万美元。

sentences.en: I'm supposed to have like 54 million pesos in a Mexican bank account.
sentences.zh: 我本该在一个墨西哥银行账户里有大约5400万比索。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So this is now no longer just about his timeshare.
sentences.zh: 所以这现在不仅仅是关于他的分时度假屋了。

sentences.en: They are now partners in a real estate investment.
sentences.zh: 他们现在是房地产投资的伙伴了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's this whole new round of fees and fines associated with that.
sentences.zh: 与之相关的还有全新的一轮费用和罚款。

sentences.en: So how many payments would you say?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得有多少笔付款？

sentences.en: Oh, geez.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Quite a few.
sentences.zh: 相当多。

sentences.en: A couple dozen at least, maybe more.
sentences.zh: 至少几十笔，可能更多。

sentences.zh: 你最后一次付款是什么时候？

sentences.en: It would have been 17 January.
sentences.zh: 应该是1月17日。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.zh: 那笔钱是做什么用的？

sentences.en: Good question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: And all along, he believed it was necessary to pay these costs just to get the money that he's owed.
sentences.zh: 一路上，他都认为有必要支付这些费用，才能拿到他应得的钱。

sentences.en: You know, the amount of money that I've sent to Mexico is just freaking exorbitant.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我汇往墨西哥的金额简直是特么的太离谱了。

sentences.en: And, I mean, it is approaching $900,000 or more.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，这笔钱正逼近甚至超过 90 万美元。

sentences.en: Wow, okay.
sentences.zh: 哇，好吧。

sentences.en: And at this point, he's sent about $900,000 to Mexico over about a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，在一年半的时间里，他已经向墨西哥汇了大约 90 万美元。

sentences.en: Nearly a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 将近一百万美元。

sentences.en: That was almost all the money that he and his wife had saved for their retirement.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是他和妻子为退休攒下的全部积蓄。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It also included money from the sale of James' childhood home and money that he had borrowed from his daughter and son-in-law, about $150,000 from them.
sentences.zh: 其中还包括出售詹姆斯童年住宅的钱，以及他向女儿和女婿借的钱，大约有 15 万美元。

sentences.en: It's awful.

sentences.en: So they were completely cleaned out by these guys.

sentences.en: And when we start talking, it was clear to me that he just did not know what to think, even after losing this much money.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: So I asked him if he could start recording his phone calls with the scammers.
sentences.zh: 所以我问他是否可以开始录下他与骗子的通话。

sentences.en: Would you be so kind as to do me a favor?

sentences.en: been so he shared the recordings of these calls that he'd had with these scammers over the last

sentences.en: year or so and it was just remarkable it gave me huge insight into how the scam worked and

sentences.en: the way that it sounded over the phone this is michael in i think he's trying to call me i I couldn't get through.

sentences.en: One second.

sentences.en: The first is that these scammers had really gotten to know James so well, And they really made James believe that Worry-Free was a company that was working for him.
sentences.zh: 首先，这些骗子对詹姆斯的了解实在是太深了，他们让詹姆斯深信“无忧”是一家为他服务的公司。

sentences.zh: 听着，我在我这边已经尽我所能、竭尽全力了。

sentences.zh: 所以，詹姆斯，听着，就像我一开始对你说的，我会解决这个问题的，我们在做了。

sentences.en: I just need you to, you know, focus on the goal.
sentences.zh: 我只需要你，你知道的，专注于目标。

sentences.en: They would refocus the conversation on what James needed to do to get his money back.
sentences.zh: 他们会把谈话重新引导到詹姆斯需要做什么才能拿回他的钱上。

sentences.en: Look, if you make your payment as a security deposit, right away they will release the funds to you.
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你把这笔款项作为保证金支付，他们马上就会把资金释放给你。

sentences.en: And the other thing...

sentences.zh: 他基本上开始对詹姆斯大喊大叫。

sentences.zh: 哇，所以这些骗子基本上是在玩红脸白脸的把戏，好让詹姆斯打消离开的念头，并榨干他身上的最后一分钱。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.zh: 如果你提供你的电子邮件联系信息，我当然很乐意将我银行账户的所有电汇信息转发给你

sentences.en: from my bank account to you so that you can see where those funds went.
sentences.zh: ，这样你就能看到这些资金去了哪里。

sentences.en: Yeah, that would be great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: I have your email.
sentences.zh: 我有你的邮箱了。

sentences.en: James asks me, a reporter who's based in Mexico, who speaks the language, if I could help him figure out where his money had gone to.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯问我——一个常驻墨西哥、会说当地语言的记者——能否帮他弄清楚他的钱究竟去了哪里。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your assistance.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激您的帮助。

sentences.en: I'm just doing my job.
sentences.zh: 我只是在做我的工作。

sentences.en: Thanks again, and we'll talk soon.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢，我们很快再聊。

sentences.en: And the only way that I could figure that out was to understand who was on the other side of the phone.
sentences.zh: 而我弄清楚这一点的唯一方法，就是弄明白电话那头究竟是什么人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“连线”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“字母包”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, Maria, who was on the other side of that phone line?
sentences.zh: 那么，玛丽亚，电话那头到底是谁？

sentences.en: So, by the time that I'd met James, I'd already gotten a tip from U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我见到詹姆斯之前，我就已经从美国执法机构得到了一条线索，

sentences.en: law enforcement agencies that they were seeing a new trend.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一个新趋势。

sentences.en: Mexican drug cartels were getting involved in the timeshare scam industry.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥贩毒集团正在介入分时度假诈骗行业。

sentences.en: Drug cartels.
sentences.zh: 贩毒集团？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And not just any drug cartel.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是普通的贩毒集团。

sentences.en: This is one of the most notorious, violent, bloody drug cartels that exists in Mexico and Latin America, the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.
sentences.zh: 这是墨西哥和拉丁美洲现存最臭名昭著、最暴力、最血腥的贩毒集团之一——哈利斯科新一代贩毒集团。

sentences.en: And when I looked at James's bank records, guess what?
sentences.zh: 当我查看詹姆斯的银行记录时，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: All the money that he was sending was going to various bank accounts that were all located in Jalisco State in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他汇出的所有钱都流向了位于墨西哥哈利斯科州的各个银行账户。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So why would the drug cartels get into the timeshare scamming business?
sentences.zh: 那么，贩毒集团为什么会涉足分时度假诈骗业务呢？

sentences.en: It is a huge business.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨大的生意。

sentences.en: The FBI told me that it's about $300 million in profits over the last five years.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局告诉我，在过去五年里，其利润大约达到 3 亿美元。

sentences.en: But the thing is, is that the potential for it to actually be multitudes more is huge because the FBI estimates that most of the scams are actually not even reported.
sentences.zh: 但关键是，由于联邦调查局估计大多数诈骗甚至根本没有被举报，其潜在规模实际上可能会大得多。

sentences.en: In fact, only about 20% are.
sentences.zh: 事实上，只有大约 20% 的案件被举报。

sentences.en: So that means the total timeshare scam business could actually be much larger than the $300 million that they have knowledge of over the last five years.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，分时度假诈骗的总规模实际上可能远超他们在过去五年中所了解到的 3 亿美元。

sentences.en: But wait, I thought the drug business was a pretty lucrative business in itself.
sentences.zh: 等等，我以为毒品生意本身就是一笔非常暴利的生意。

sentences.en: So why get into the scamming of elderly people for their properties in Lake Tahoe?
sentences.zh: 那为什么还要去诈骗老年人太浩湖的房产呢？

sentences.en: Well, you have to remember that these drug cartels, they're not just doing one thing, they're doing multiple things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你必须记住，这些贩毒集团不只做一件事，他们做很多事情。

sentences.en: They're essentially conglomerates because it's really expensive to run a cartel.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是企业集团，因为运营一个贩毒集团成本很高。

sentences.en: You need to pay off officials, both Mexican and American.
sentences.zh: 你需要贿赂墨西哥和美国的官员。

sentences.en: You need to maintain basically an army in order to secure your routes up to the United States, ports of entry into Mexico from Colombia.
sentences.zh: 为了保障通往美国的贩毒路线以及从哥伦比亚进入墨西哥的入境港口的安全，你基本上需要维持一支军队。

sentences.en: And like any big business, you need to diversify your income to make sure that you keep the money flowing because you never know when one business is going to be
sentences.zh: 就像任何大企业一样，你需要多元化收入以确保资金源源不断，因为你永远不知道哪项生意会被当局查封或被竞争对手接管。

sentences.en: shut down by authorities or taken over by your rivals.
sentences.zh: 被当局查封或被你的竞争对手吞并。

sentences.en: We've reported that they're now in the avocado business and the construction business.
sentences.zh: 我们曾报道过他们现在涉足牛油果生意和建筑业。

sentences.en: And timeshare fraud is basically no different than any of those.
sentences.zh: 分时度假诈骗其实与其中任何一项都没有什么不同。

sentences.en: So we're seeing that the cartels have their fingers in many pies, the legitimate and the illegitimate economy here in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到，贩毒集团在这里的合法经济和非法经济中都插手了许多领域。

sentences.en: It's kind of fascinating to think of these drug cartels as, like, sprawling, diversified business empires.
sentences.zh: 把这些贩毒集团想象成庞大、多元化的商业帝国，这有点令人着迷。

sentences.en: But when did the cartels first get into the scamming business?
sentences.zh: 但是贩毒集团是什么时候开始涉足诈骗生意的呢？

sentences.en: So Jalisco New Generation started about 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 哈利斯科新一代贩毒集团大约在 15 年前成立。

sentences.en: And when they started to consolidate their empire in Jalisco State, they found that there
sentences.zh: 当他们开始巩固自己在哈利斯科州的帝国时，他们发现全州有各种各样由不同黑帮经营的诈骗分时度假呼叫中心，

sentences.en: were all these scam timeshare call centers all over the state that were being run by various
sentences.zh: 由各种势力经营，

sentences.en: players and that this was a huge, huge moneymaker because essentially all you have to do is call up retired senior citizens in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这是一个巨大的摇钱树，因为基本上你只需要打电话给美国和加拿大的退休老年公民。

sentences.en: and Canada.
sentences.zh: 和加拿大的老人。

sentences.en: It doesn't take that much money to run that kind of a scheme.
sentences.zh: 运营这种计划不需要花太多钱。

sentences.en: There's no products you're making.
sentences.zh: 你不需要生产任何产品。

sentences.en: So essentially they conducted a hostile takeover of these call centers.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们基本上对这些呼叫中心进行了一次恶意收购。

sentences.en: They went in, they kicked down doors and dragged out the people who were managing these call centers by their hair and threatened to kill them unless they gave up the
sentences.zh: 他们闯进去，踹开大门，揪着这些呼叫中心管理人员的头发把他们拖出来，威胁他们如果不交出呼叫中心，或者开始交出他们盈利的分成，就要杀了他们。

sentences.en: call centers or started handing over a cut of what they made.
sentences.zh: 或者开始交出他们的一半利润。

sentences.en: And slowly, slowly, Jalisco
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，慢慢地，哈利斯科

sentences.en: New Generation cartel took over the entire timeshare fraud industry.
sentences.zh: 新一代贩毒集团接管了整个分时度假诈骗产业。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Were you able to find any of these call centers?
sentences.zh: 你找到这些呼叫中心了吗？

sentences.en: So these call centers are pretty hard to find.
sentences.zh: 这些呼叫中心很难找到。

sentences.en: They look like any other storefront.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来就像任何其他的店面一样。

sentences.en: But I was able to visit two that were located in an upscale neighborhood in Guadalajara, which is the capital of Jalisco State.
sentences.zh: 但我得以参观了位于哈利斯科州首府瓜达拉哈拉高档社区的两家。

sentences.en: And it was just really perturbing because it was just so normal.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人不安，因为一切看起来都太正常了。

sentences.en: Two villas about a mile away from each other, outside of one villa, parents were walking by holding their children's hands as they, you know, did drop off at school.
sentences.zh: 两栋别墅相距约一英里，在其中一栋别墅外，父母们手拉着手走过，送孩子们去上学。

sentences.en: It was right next to a park where people taking their morning exercise or their dogs for a walk.
sentences.zh: 它紧挨着一个公园，人们在那里进行晨练或遛狗。

sentences.en: There was no real sign that the cartel was doing business there.
sentences.zh: 没有任何真正的迹象表明贩毒集团在那里做生意。

sentences.en: But a few months before,
sentences.zh: 但在几个月前，

sentences.en: Mexican law enforcement had found the bodies of eight young people who had used to work at one of these call centers and said that the Jalisco cartel had killed them.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥执法部门发现了八名年轻人的尸体，他们曾在这个呼叫中心工作过，并称哈利斯科贩毒集团杀害了他们。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: So I wasn't able to talk directly to any of the victims' families.
sentences.zh: 所以我无法直接与任何受害者家属交谈。

sentences.en: They're just too scared.
sentences.zh: 他们实在太害怕了。

sentences.en: But in general, this is usually how it starts.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，事情通常是这样开始的。

sentences.en: The cartel seeks out English speakers to work for their call centers.
sentences.zh: 贩毒集团物色会说英语的人来他们的呼叫中心工作。

sentences.en: Sometimes they don't even tell them what exactly they're doing.
sentences.zh: 有时他们甚至不告诉他们具体在做什么。

sentences.en: They would tell the recruits that the job was adjacent to the hotel industry.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉新招募的人，这份工作与酒店行业有关。

sentences.en: You have to remember Jalisco is a huge, huge tourism magnet for Americans and Canadians and others.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，哈利斯科州对美国人、加拿大人和其他人来说是一个巨大的、极具吸引力的旅游胜地。

sentences.en: And the cartel would get their call lists from bribing hotel employees to give them the names of people who stayed at these hotels.
sentences.zh: 卡特尔通过贿赂酒店员工获取入住这些酒店的人的名单，从而得到他们的通话名单。

sentences.en: and also at the timeshare resorts.
sentences.zh: 还有分时度假村的名单。

sentences.en: And the people who would work at the call centers are provided the names and a manual of what you need to do when you call,
sentences.zh: 在呼叫中心工作的人会拿到这些名单以及一本操作手册，告诉你打电话时需要做什么，

sentences.en: kind of like a loose script of how to try to suck as much money as you can out of these people up north in Canada and the States.
sentences.zh: 有点像是一个大致的剧本，教你如何尽可能多地从北方美国和加拿大的这些人身上榨取钱财。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: So we don't know for sure what exactly happened with the eight young Mexicans who were killed last year,
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不确定去年被杀的八名年轻墨西哥人究竟发生了什么，

sentences.en: But through an intermediary, one sibling told us that when their family member knew what their job actually was,

sentences.en: But the Jalisco New Generation cartel is known for being extremely brutal.
sentences.zh: 但哈利斯科新一代贩毒集团以极其残忍闻名。

sentences.en: They chop off heads and they'll put them on the gates of a playground, for instance, so that everybody in the neighborhood knows what went down.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们会砍下人头，把它们挂在游乐场的铁门上，好让附近所有人都知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And in this case, it's possible that they wanted to send a warning that there's no defection from their timeshare call centers.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们可能是想发出一个警告，即他们的分时度假呼叫中心绝不允许背叛。

sentences.en: So basically making a very scary example of these guys, in case anyone else is thinking about quitting one of the call centers.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是拿这些人杀鸡儆猴，以防其他人也动了退出呼叫中心的念头。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And one man who runs an organization who advocates for missing people and actually organizes search parties to comb the forests of Jalisco State looking for the missing
sentences.zh: 有一个人经营着一个倡导寻找失踪人员的组织，甚至组织搜救队去哈利斯科州的森林里寻找失踪者，

sentences.en: says that he knows of about 30 people who have disappeared from the call centers in Jalisco State since 2017.
sentences.zh: 他说，据他所知，自2017年以来，已有大约30人从哈利斯科州的呼叫中心失踪。

sentences.en: So while Americans and Canadians might be losing much of their life savings, in Mexico, this is actually deadly.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然美国人和加拿大人可能损失了大半的毕生积蓄，但在墨西哥，这实际上是会死人的。

sentences.en: Are the authorities doing anything about this?
sentences.zh: 当局对此有什么行动吗？

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: Other than the fact that these two call centers were shut down, the authorities haven't arrested others.
sentences.zh: 除了这两家呼叫中心被关闭之外，当局并没有逮捕其他人。

sentences.en: They're not putting pressure on Mexican banks, for instance, to look into these payments coming from senior citizens in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们没有向墨西哥的银行施压，去调查这些来自美国老年人的汇款，

sentences.en: or Canada.
sentences.zh: 或者加拿大。

sentences.en: And you have to remember that people are really afraid.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须记住，人们真的很害怕。

sentences.en: But you also have to remember that in Mexico, things are not that clear.
sentences.zh: 但你也必须记住，在墨西哥，情况并没有那么明朗。

sentences.en: There is a lot of corruption and government collusion with organized crime and cartels.
sentences.zh: 这里存在大量腐败，政府与有组织犯罪和贩毒集团相互勾结。

sentences.en: And the tourism industry, it is huge in Mexico and particularly in Jalisco State.
sentences.zh: 而且旅游业在墨西哥规模巨大，特别是在哈利斯科州。

sentences.en: This is a multi-billion dollar industry.
sentences.zh: 这是一个价值数十亿美元的产业。

sentences.en: They don't want Americans or Canadians or Europeans who are coming to Jalisco for its beautiful beaches and its mountains to hear about these stories.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望那些为了美丽的海滩和山脉来到哈利斯科的美国人、加拿大人或欧洲人听到这些故事，

sentences.en: regarding the cartels being involved in the tourism industry and think, you know,
sentences.zh: 关于贩毒集团卷入旅游业的故事，然后心想：

sentences.en: I'm not going to send my family there for that beach vacation.
sentences.zh: 我才不把家人送到那种地方去过海滩假期呢。

sentences.en: It's just simply too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这实在太危险了。

sentences.en: So everybody has an incentive to have the scam continue, whether because they're too afraid and don't want to speak out or because they're in on it.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都有动机让这场骗局继续下去，要么是因为他们太害怕而不敢发声，要么是因为他们是同谋。

sentences.en: So in a way, local authorities have an interest and sweeping it under the carpet in order to just maintain this idea of a tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，地方当局有动机把事情掩盖起来，仅仅为了维持这是一个旅游胜地的形象。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, the spokeswoman for the prosecutor's office was very responsive to me until I told her what I wanted to ask her questions about.
sentences.zh: 我是说，检察官办公室的新闻发言人一开始对我很热情，直到我告诉她我想问她什么问题。

sentences.en: And then she just simply never answered any of my texts or phone calls.
sentences.zh: 然后她就再也没有回复过我的任何短信或电话。

sentences.en: So Maria, based on everything you know, all the information you have, would you say that you're confident that the cartels were the ones who scammed James?
sentences.zh: 那么，玛丽亚，基于你所了解的一切、你掌握的所有信息，你敢肯定卡特尔就是诈骗詹姆斯的人吗？
是的，百分之百。

sentences.en: Everything I've seen points in that direction.
sentences.zh: 我看到的一切都指向那个方向。

sentences.en: What did James say when you told him this?
sentences.zh: 当你把这事告诉詹姆斯时，他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So, it took him quite a while to really allow himself to believe it.
sentences.zh: 所以，他花了相当长的时间才真正让自己相信这一点。

sentences.en: On the advice of his lawyers, he stopped picking up the phone calls.
sentences.zh: 在律师的建议下，他不再接听电话。

sentences.en: And about a week ago, they stopped.
sentences.zh: 大约一周前，他们停了下来。

sentences.en: after the scammers kept trying to call him.
sentences.zh: 在那之前骗子一直试图给他打电话。

sentences.en: But you said he was in it for over a year.
sentences.zh: 但你说他陷在里面有一年多了。

sentences.en: Why do you think it took him so long?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么他花了这么长时间？

sentences.en: Can you tell me, after all of that that had been presented to you, why do you think you weren't willing to be entirely convinced?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我，在摆在你面前这一切证据之后，你为什么觉得当时还不愿意完全相信呢？

sentences.en: Well, I actually asked him that question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我其实问过他这个问题。

sentences.en: That's a very good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: Why wasn't I able to pick up on that right away?
sentences.zh: 为什么我当时没能立刻察觉到这一点？

sentences.en: And I think in the back of my mind, I'm finding out that I'm a little more stubborn than I thought I was.
sentences.zh: 我想在我的心底，我发现自己比想象中要固执一些。

sentences.en: And for him, it was pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，这相当复杂。

sentences.en: And I think that I didn't want to believe that I had fallen for this.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时是不想承认自己竟然上当受骗了。

sentences.en: I didn't feel I was that foolish and stupid when it came to this.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上，我不觉得自己会那么愚蠢。

sentences.en: You know, I guess I didn't want to believe that I could be fooled.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我猜我就是不想相信自己会被人当猴耍。

sentences.en: to come to terms with the fact that he had lost so much money was to come to terms with the fact
sentences.zh: 要接受他失去了这么多钱这一事实，就等于要接受这样一个事实：

sentences.en: that he wasn't the person that he thought that he was that he wasn't this kind of you know clever
sentences.zh: 他并不是自己想象中的那种人，他不是那种精明的、

sentences.en: former law enforcement officer who was used to fighting the bad guys and and winning
sentences.zh: 习惯了打击坏人并取得胜利的前执法人员。

sentences.en: You know, I'm disappointed in myself.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我对感到自己很失望。

sentences.en: There's a huge level of anger towards the perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 对施害者有着极大的愤怒。

sentences.en: And, yeah, all of those things wrapped into one.
sentences.zh: 是的，所有这些情绪交织在了一起。

sentences.en: And part of that, I think, contributes to not wanting to actually believe that I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想，部分原因在于不愿意真正承认自己错了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我理解。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I can hear the pain in your voice.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉，我能听出你声音里的痛苦。

sentences.en: yeah some of it's based on shame right that he lost all this money everything that he's worked
sentences.zh: 是的，其中一部分是基于羞耻感，对吧，他失去了所有的钱，失去了他为之奋斗的一切，

sentences.en: for and the fact that this was all supposed to be money that his children and his grandchildren
sentences.zh: 而且这些本该是留给他的孩子们和孙辈们继承的钱，

sentences.en: were going to inherit and now it's gone and have you told your daughter that you think you've kind
sentences.zh: 而现在都没了。你有没有把你觉得你可能已经接受了这可能是一场骗局这件事告诉你的女儿？

sentences.en: of come to terms with the fact that this might have been a scam oh she's she's been uh involved
sentences.zh: 哦，她，她一直都有参与其中。

sentences.en: Yeah, they know.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们知道。

sentences.en: My daughter does.
sentences.zh: 我女儿知道。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, this is a tough time.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，这段时间对你来说很艰难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I've got to make some sort of arrangements to compensate them for this on top of our regular debt.
sentences.zh: 所以我得想点办法来弥补他们，除了我们日常的债务之外。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's been a swell experience.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一次相当美妙的经历。

sentences.en: All of it brought on by my, evidently, my stubbornness to believe that I couldn't possibly be a victim.
sentences.zh: 这一切显然都是因为我固执地认为自己绝不可能成为受害者。

sentences.en: How's your wife doing throughout this whole process with this new knowledge?
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一切以及得知这些新情况后，你妻子现在怎么样了？

sentences.en: She's not real happy, obviously, at all.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，她一点也不高兴。

sentences.en: I hear a lot of, I told you so.
sentences.zh: 我听到最多的话就是“我早就告诉你了”。

sentences.en: And at this point, I've got no defense.
sentences.zh: 到了这个地步，我无话可说。

sentences.en: She's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 她是完全正确的。

sentences.en: No question about it.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Do you worry this is going to affect your marriage?
sentences.zh: 你担心这会影响你们的婚姻吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There has been an effect.
sentences.zh: 确实产生了影响。

sentences.en: And do you think that at this point there's any way for James and his family to get some kind of justice or at least find some kind of closure?
sentences.zh: 你认为到了这一步，詹姆斯和他的家人还有什么办法能讨回一些公道，或者至少了却这桩心事吗？

sentences.en: Ay, justice?
sentences.zh: 唉，公道？

sentences.en: Unlikely.
sentences.zh: 不太可能。

sentences.en: At this point, I'm not necessarily expecting much in the way of restitution.
sentences.zh: 事到如今，我对追回损失不抱太大希望。

sentences.en: And as for closure, it's a little bit too soon to tell.
sentences.zh: 至于释怀，现在说还为时过早。

sentences.en: in a way james has gone through several stages of acceptance of for what happened there's fear there's shame there's resignation and now he's talking to me partly because he feels
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，詹姆斯经历了对发生的事情的几个接受阶段：有恐惧、有羞耻、有无奈，现在他之所以跟我谈，部分原因是他觉得这是一种公共服务，你知道的，他必须发声，好让别人不要再经历他所经历的事，不要再掉入这个骗局。我想这也帮他在某种程度上找回了一些掌控感，在过去的一年半里，

sentences.en: like it's a public service that you know he needs to be vocal so that other people don't go through
sentences.zh: 他简直任由这些一周给他打好几次电话的人摆布。

sentences.en: what he's gone through and fall for the scam and i think it also kind of helps him feel a little bit empowered in a situation for over the last year and a half.
sentences.zh: 我想尽可能把更多信息提供给尽可能多的官方机构。

sentences.en: He was kind of at the mercy of these people who were calling him multiple times a week.
sentences.zh: 我现在心里憋着一股火，这股怒火已经让我决定绝不轻易放过此事。

sentences.en: I want to try to get as much information to as many of these official organizations as possible.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛丽亚，谢谢你。

sentences.en: I have a streak of anger through me now that I've developed to the point where I'm not going to let this go.
